The '''MKI hyperdrive module''' was a type of [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] manufactured by [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]]. The unit was originally [[Introducing Incom's T-65 "X-Wing" Space Superiority Fighter|advertized]] as being installed on the [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]],<ref name="TRG1-109" /> and were the standard model included on the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] once they entered production.<ref name="SWS">''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]''</ref>
